notes: 1.1.165: Interact Reel - run by number or by TIME, comments (Web mode accounts; Facebook's phone site has no reel comments), reels that never load are not counted; newsfeed stays on the feed - no swipe starts on a name/link, no tiny swipes that act as taps, any other page (profile / Friends / video) -> Back to the feed; profile preview card closed; 'What happened' / 'Happy Birthday' notices closed at once; a slow page load is retried instead of ending the feed; no Reels after a failed feed; stuck feed / left feed -> GitHub with screenshot; clear Status Detail (Newsfeed/Reels, seconds, minutes left).
